rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notification is a 2.4 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning), status notified; completed felling overlaps only 1.9% of the polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

One eligible species, Goodyera repens (VU, site-bound vascular plant; threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness), is recorded within 1000 m; nearest record 881 m, uncertainty 10 m, latest record 2026. None within 250 m.
Several site-bound forest NT fungi and a moss are recorded at 850-992 m. None are within 250 m, so the 3-NT-within-250 m criterion is not met.
Within 250 m only mobile birds (and a non-forest NT plant) are recorded. They are supporting evidence only and none are eligible.
Near-site effort is adequate: 77 records and 14 observation days within 250 m, none inside the polygon, and 1000 m effort is above the county median (237 vs 58.5).

uncertainties: Eligible record is 881 m away; it says nothing certain about the stand itself.
Records inside the polygon are zero, but this does not show that no species are there.
The 77 records within 250 m have 240 m coordinate uncertainty, so their true positions relative to the polygon are imprecise.
not_established: Whether Goodyera repens or any red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
The habitat quality or age of the stand.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for forest-habitat values, given the nearby VU Goodyera repens and the NT fungi, before felling can begin. Review the 2022 partial felling overlap (0.047 ha) as well.
